## About

I'm an applied mathematician working at the intersection of **analytics,
data science and machine learning**, with a research background in
**stochastic algorithms and control theory**. Staff/manager-level
experience in consumer tech as a business analyst and data analyst,
building experimentation, optimization and modeling systems that hold up
both mathematically and in production.

I write up the technical notes I keep for myself — on experimentation
design, optimization and stochastic modeling — when they turn out useful
enough to share. See [Projects & Articles](projects.qmd) for the polished
ones and [Blog](blog.qmd) for looser, occasional notes.
